newsitem.title: BERMUDA: Global Capital forms new Lloyd's syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Global Capital forms new Lloyd's syndicate.

text.p: Global Capital Reinsurance Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of GCR Holdings Ltd, said it is forming within Lloyd's of London a new corporate syndicate for the 1997 underwriting year.
The new syndicate, 2741, will underwrite in parallel to Archer Marine Syndicate 741, P.P.A Wright and Others, which specializes in marine hull and energy business.

Capacity for the new syndicate will be provided by Global Capital Reinsurance Ltd of Bermuda, which is backing underwriter Peter Wright through a newly-formed corporate member, Global Capital Underwriting Ltd.
Risks will be divided between the two syndicates in a fixed proportion, relative to their respective capacities.
Global Capital Reinsurance Ltd specializes in worldwide property catastrophe reinsurance.
"We are excited about this affiliation with Archer Marine Syndicate 741 and look forward to a long, stable and profitable relationship," said Global Capital chief executive Lawrence Doyle.
"Syndicate 741 represents a further expansion by Global Capital Re in the marine lines of business," he said.
"Peter Wright and his experienced team's underwriting approach meshes well with Global Capital's conservative underwriting philosophy.

"Both firms are committed to targeting and capturing the highest quality accounts. Further, Peter Wright's analytical approach to underpin the assessment of risk is compatible with our reliance on computer modeling systems to assist our underwriters, he said.

Underwriter Peter Wright said the committed capacity from fellow insurance professionals will bring stability to the combined syndicates and will be an enormous benefit to current Members of Syndicate 741.
"I intend to continue my conservative underwriting policy and to focus on quality accounts in order to maximize the profit potential for all the Members of Syndicates 741 and 2741," he said.
